name: Overgrown Zealot
oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{T}: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to turn permanents face up.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to turn permanents face up.

needs.what: a mana_restriction purpose meaning 'only to turn permanents face up' (the morph/megamorph/disguise/manifest/cloak special action, 116.2b), e.g. {"face_up": "any"}, with Game._turn_face_up paying under that purpose instead of the generic OTHER_PAYMENT, so the mana pays a face-up cost and nothing else
needs.why_existing_wont_do: compile_restriction knows only 'cast', 'activate' and 'other'. 'other' takes only 'any' and covers every non-cast, non-activation payment (ward, attack taxes, 'you may pay'), so it is strictly broader than the printed text; and a restriction with neither 'cast' nor 'activate' is refused as permitting nothing. _turn_face_up pays with purpose=OTHER_PAYMENT, so no restriction can single out the face-up action. The mana half itself (add_mana with any_one_color and amount 2) is expressible.
